rules.description: A contract for the sale or supply of goods must describe the goods. In a sale by description the goods must correspond with the description.
A contract of sale must fix or provide a means to ascertain the price of the goods.
rules.statutory_reference: Sale of Goods Act 1930 – S.9, S.10

rules.description: A contract for the sale/supply of goods must address delivery (mode, place, time) — the seller's duty to deliver and the buyer's to accept.
rules.statutory_reference: Sale of Goods Act 1930 – S.31 to S.39

rules.description: A contract for the sale of goods should state when property (title) and risk pass from seller to buyer.
rules.statutory_reference: Sale of Goods Act 1930 – S.19 to S.26

rules.description: A contract for the sale of goods should address quality/fitness — implied conditions of merchantable quality and fitness for purpose unless validly excluded.
